title: MicroCoder: code, data, models and ESP32-S3 firmware for "How Small Can a Code Model Be?"
description: Reproducible study of 0.53-3.05M-parameter Python code models for microcontrollers: IoT-oriented benchmark with executable unit tests and a train/test leakage audit, training and evaluation code, trained checkpoints, a portable INT8 C inference engine and tokenizer, ESP-IDF v5.4.2 firmware for the ESP32-S3 with its host simulation, and the paper sources. Code: MIT. Data, models, results and paper text: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
